meetings.headline: Planning Board continued the 39 Main Street school site plan hearing to May 8 and leaned toward a 15-member master plan committee.
meetings.summary: The board opened the site plan hearing for a school use with parking at 39 Main Street and continued it pending peer review and Conservation Commission action. It discussed the size and makeup of a master plan steering committee and agreed to circulate a 15-member draft. It also signed a decision, approved minutes, took committee reports, and discussed a model groundwater protection bylaw.
